title: 第21章 林小满的担心第22章 下一个目标
lines: 铁城后府的独门小院，把城外军队整编时的踏步声、武器碰撞的细碎响声，还有人声嘈杂，都挡在了外面。三天灾变厮杀带来的那股压力，被死死关在了这个又小又静的院子里。
风停了。
屋檐角一动不动，树叶也不晃，整个院子静得像一潭死水，耳朵里只剩空荡荡的嗡鸣。空气又沉又闷，压得人胸口发紧。地上残留的微弱辐射余温，混着泥土的腥霉味，在低处慢慢往下沉，吸进肺里有一股淡淡的涩钝感，好久都散不掉。
苏野抬手解开脖子旁边的束带，把步枪斜靠在墙角。金属枪身上还沾着荒原的细灰和干掉的畸变血垢，冷冷硬硬的，在昏暗的天光下格外扎眼。他肩背的肌肉还保持着作战时的僵硬，没完全放松下来，眼神又冷又沉，飞快扫过院子的四面墙、屋檐死角、门缝阴影，做完最后一次本能的警戒。
“我去巡查城防，排查整编部队的异动。”
声音平平的，没什么温度，听不出疲惫，也听不出松懈，只剩下厮杀过后固化下来的生存习惯。
说完，他脚步轻踏，身影一闪就出了院门。木门轻轻合上，咔嗒一声轻响，把外面最后一点动静也切断了。院子里的寂静，又深了一层。
现在院里就剩两个人。
陆寻站在原地，之前靠意志硬撑的身体，一下子全垮了。
三天三夜不停地对抗地脉能量、精神力反复透支、辐射粒子持续侵蚀，再加上左腿旧伤一阵阵的酸胀拉扯……所有这些，正顺着血管和四肢蔓延开来。不是尖锐的疼，是钻进骨头缝里的那种发麻、发沉，死死粘住每一寸肌肉，抽走了大半支撑身体的力气。
他脸上惨白没血色，嘴唇发青，眼里的光彻底没了，只剩一片深灰的倦意。看远处的东西发虚、发灰，还有点重影，身体不受控制地微微晃了晃，又被他靠着求生的本能死死定住，没真的踉跄。
胸口那枚十字徽章，没有明火，也不发烫，只剩下持续不断的、低低的皮肉灼钝感。表层皮肤一直发麻——这是灾变能量残留在体内、还没完全代谢掉的反常迹象。
他全程没出声，没喘粗气，没皱眉头，没露出半点痛苦的样子，就靠着惯性，硬扛下了身体所有的透支。
林小满站在他侧后方半步远的地方，眉头一直紧紧拧着，眉心那根神经还残留着感知过载后的细密刺痛。
她的精神脉络里，还翻滚着地脉崩裂留下的紊乱余波，眼睛看东西总蒙着一层极淡的灰雾——这是高强度精神梳理后的后遗症，躲不掉。她现在没法战斗，没法御敌，唯一剩下的感知能力，就是持续的神经劳损和身体发虚。
这三天，她的精神丝线一直贴着陆寻的状态，清楚地感觉到他每一次心神快要溃散、每一次能量对冲带来的身体颤抖、每一次强行压下去的失衡破绽。别人眼里看到的平定灾变、收服霸主的利落，说到底，是无数次透支到极限，才勉强堆出来的平稳。
无声，无波，无澜，没有任何情绪露在外面。
她走上前，指尖轻轻碰了碰陆寻的小臂。
皮肤温度偏凉，肌肉僵硬得像块板子，这是长期用力对抗、神经绷到极点才会有的僵直。摸上去又薄又紧，没有半点松动的余地。
一个字说出口，声音又轻又急，还发虚，是感知过载后气虚的自然反应。
陆寻没应声，没摇头，也没点头。身体顺着那一点借来的力，慢慢挪了两步，在廊下的石凳上坐了下来。
石面冰冷刺骨，透过单薄的衣服压住腰背那股虚浮的眩晕感，强行稳住了他摇晃的平衡。他脊背微微塌下去，脖子松垂，目光落在面前死寂的青砖地上。呼吸又匀又冷，又轻又慢，胸口起伏几乎看不见，也听不见声音。
林小满转身去取水。
城里的净水虽然褪掉了辐射浊质，却还带着一股地底死水特有的沉闷土味。棉布方巾浸湿拧干，微凉的触感贴上皮肤——没有温和，只有单调的、低低的涩意。
她走回来，抬手，动作又轻又缓，很克制，没有多余的温柔姿态，只是用最稳妥的动作，擦去陆寻额头、鬓角、下巴上积的灰和冷汗。
指腹碰到他绷得僵硬的下颌线条，碰到他透支后凹陷下去的脸颊轮廓，碰到皮肤表面残留的那层细微的辐射麻感。
废土的规则直白又残酷。
厮杀可以躲，异兽可以避，唯独地脉灾变和辐射侵蚀，无解。无数死者的结局都一样：无形的能量抽干生机，身体一点点朽坏，无声无息地消失，没有墓碑，没有痕迹，没有归处。
过去三天里，只要陆寻心神稍一松懈、力道稍有松动，荒原废墟下反扑的地脉能量，就会直接冲垮他的精神根基。没人能救，也没人能替。
现在危机落幕，喧嚣散尽，那些被高压战事掩盖的凶险，才化成生理上的寒意，顺着脊椎一点点爬上来。
林小满端着水凑近，杯沿轻轻碰了碰他干涩起皮的嘴唇，慢慢把清水倾进去。
水流过喉咙，压下深处那股干涩发麻的感觉。陆寻紧绷的肩背，极其细微地松了一瞬。
content_en:
The private courtyard at the rear of Tiecheng blocked out the sounds of the troops reorganizing outside the city, the tinny sounds of weapons clashing, and the noise of people. The pressure caused by the three days of catastrophic fighting was tightly locked in this small and quiet courtyard.
The wind stopped.
The corners of the roof were motionless, and the leaves did not move. The whole yard was as quiet as a pool of stagnant water, and there was only an empty hum in the ears. The air was heavy and stuffy, making one's chest feel tight. The weak residual heat of radiation on the ground, mixed with the musty smell of earth, slowly sank to the lower level, and there was a faint dull feeling in the lungs that could not be dissipated for a long time.
Su Ye raised his hand to untie the belt around his neck and leaned the rifle against the corner. The metal gun was still stained with the fine ash of the wasteland and the dried blood stains of the distortion. It was cold and hard, and it was particularly eye-catching in the dim skylight. The muscles on his shoulders and back were still as stiff as during battle, and had not completely relaxed. His eyes were cold and heavy, and he quickly scanned the four walls of the yard, the dead corners of the eaves, and the shadows of the door cracks, completing his last instinctive warning.
"I'm going to inspect the city defense and investigate any changes in the reorganized troops."
The voice was flat, with no warmth. There was no hint of fatigue or relaxation, only the survival habits solidified after fighting.
After saying that, he stepped lightly and walked out of the courtyard in a flash. The wooden door closed gently with a soft click, cutting off the last movement outside. The silence in the courtyard deepened again.
Now there are only two people left in the courtyard.
Lu Xun stood there, and his body, which had been supported by his will, suddenly collapsed.
Three days and three nights of constant fighting against the energy of the earth's veins, repeated overdraft of mental power, continuous erosion of radiation particles, coupled with bursts of soreness and swelling from an old injury on his left leg... all of these are spreading along the blood vessels and limbs. It's not a sharp pain, it's the kind of numbness and heaviness that penetrates into the bones, clinging to every inch of muscle, taking away most of the strength to support the body.
His face was pale and bloodless, his lips were blue, and the light in his eyes was completely gone, leaving only a dark gray look of tiredness. Seeing that the things in the distance were faint, gray, and a bit ghosted, his body swayed slightly uncontrollably, but was firmly fixed by his survival instinct, and he didn't really stagger.
The cross badge on the chest had neither open flame nor heat, only a constant, low burning sensation in the flesh. The superficial skin has been numbing - this is an abnormal sign that the catastrophic energy remains in the body and has not been completely metabolized.
He didn't make a sound during the whole process, didn't breathe heavily, didn't frown, didn't show the slightest sign of pain, and relied on inertia to bear all the overdraft in his body.
Lin Xiaoman stood half a step behind him, his brows furrowed tightly, and the nerve between his brows still had a fine tingling sensation caused by sensory overload.
Her mental veins were still churning with the chaotic aftermath left by the collapse of her earth veins, and her eyes were always covered with a very light gray fog - this was the sequelae of intense mental sorting, and she couldn't escape it. She was now unable to fight or defend herself against the enemy, and her only remaining ability to sense was the continued nerve strain and physical weakness.
In the past three days, her mental thread has been close to Lu Xun's state, and she clearly felt every time his mind was about to collapse, every time his body trembled due to energy confrontation, and every time he was forced to suppress the imbalance flaw. The neatness that others see in quelling disasters and subduing overlords is, in the final analysis, the result of countless overdrafts reaching the limit and barely achieving stability.
Silent, no waves, no ripples, no emotions exposed.
She stepped forward and lightly touched Lu Xun's forearm with her fingertips.
The skin temperature is cold and the muscles are as stiff as a board. This is the kind of stiffness that occurs when the nerves are stretched to the extreme after long-term exertion. It feels thin and tight, with no room for looseness.
"Sit."
When he spoke a word, his voice was soft, urgent, and weak. It was a natural reaction of feeling weak due to overload.
Lu Xun didn't respond, shook his head, or nodded. Using the borrowed strength, his body slowly moved two steps and sat down on the stone bench in the corridor.
The stone surface was bone-chilling, and the thin clothes suppressed the dizzy feeling on his back, forcibly stabilizing his shaky balance. His back slumped slightly, his neck drooped, and his eyes fell on the dead green brick floor in front of him. His breathing was even, cold, light and slow, and the rise and fall of his chest was almost invisible and inaudible.
Lin Xiaoman turned around to get water.
Although the clean water in the city has lost its radioactive turbidity, it still has a dull earthy smell unique to underground stagnant water. The cotton square is soaked and wrung out, and a slightly cool touch touches the skin - there is no gentleness, only a monotonous, low astringency.
She walked back and raised her hand. Her movements were light and slow, very restrained. There was no extra gentle gesture. She just used the safest movements to wipe away the dust and cold sweat accumulated on Lu Xun's forehead, temples, and chin.
The fingertips touched his stiff jawline, the contours of his cheeks that were sunken after overdraft, and the subtle radiating numbness that remained on the surface of his skin.
The rules of the wasteland are straightforward and cruel.
You can hide from the fighting, you can avoid the strange beasts, but there is no solution to the earth catastrophe and radiation erosion. The ending of countless dead people is the same: the invisible energy drains away the vitality, the body decays bit by bit, and disappears silently, with no tombstone, no trace, and no destination.
In the past three days, as long as Lu Xun relaxed his mind and strength even a little, the counterattack of earth energy under the wasteland and ruins would directly destroy his spiritual foundation. No one can save, no one can replace.
Now that the crisis is over and the hustle and bustle has dissipated, the dangers covered up by the high-pressure war have turned into a physical chill, creeping up the spine bit by bit.
Lin Xiaoman came closer with the water, gently touched his dry and flaky lips with the edge of the cup, and slowly poured the water in.
The water flows through the throat, suppressing the dry and numb feeling deep inside. Lu Xun's tense shoulders relaxed for a moment.
